1. Definitions
Personal Information
Under Indian law, personal information refers to any data relating to an individual that can identify that person directly or indirectly when combined with other available information.
Sensitive Personal Data or Information (SPDI)

This may include financial details, passwords, biometric information, medical records, physical or mental health conditions, sexual orientation, and other sensitive information as defined under applicable laws.
User / You
Any individual or organization that visits or interacts with our website or services.
Cookies
Small data files stored on your device that help improve website functionality and enhance your browsing experience.
